create_custom_op: create a custom PyTorch operator with a qualified name and inferred schema from type annotations
register_device_impl: register a device-specific implementation (CPU or CUDA) for an existing custom operator
register_abstract_impl: register an abstract implementation that defines output tensor properties for fake and meta tensors
register_save_for_backward: register a function that specifies what intermediate values to save for the backward pass
register_backward_formula: register a backward gradient formula that maps input names to their corresponding gradients
